reviews_captured_by_me.text: We used Melling for all of our stone work in a whole-house remodel.  Their craftsmanship is beyond compare.  Melissa was our project manager, and she went above and beyond to find the perfect slabs for our project.  Great customer-oriented company and meticulous at what they do.  We absolutely recommend them and would use them again if we ever needed stone work.
reviews_captured_by_me.owner_reply:
Response from the owner 5 months ago
Sue, thank you so much for your kind words and for trusting Melling Granite with your whole-home. Projects like yours are truly special to be part of, and we are so grateful for the opportunity.

We are especially happy to hear that Melissa took great care of you throughout the process. Finding the perfect slabs and bringing each detail together is something our team is incredibly passionate about.

Thank you again for your recommendation and for recognizing the craftsmanship and attention to detail that go into every project we complete. We hope you enjoy your beautiful space for many years to come.

reviews_captured_by_me.text: We had a great experience from the moment we went into the office until the granite was installed. We were able to select our granite at the same time as our visit and weren't expected to make a choice by looking at a picture. I would highly recommend Melling Granite & More for any project, large or small.
reviews_captured_by_me.owner_reply:
Response from the owner 4 months ago
Thank you so much, Jennifer, for your kind words and recommendation! We’re so happy to hear you had a great experience from start to finish. We believe selecting stone in person is an important part of the process, and we’re glad we could help you find the perfect natural stone for your project. Thank you for trusting Melling Granite with your home. We truly appreciate your support and hope you enjoy your new countertops for many years to come!

reviews_captured_by_me.text: I have worked in the countertop industry and I won’t take my business anywhere else! Great attention to detail. They get all of the specifics upfront so you don’t have issues later down the line. They don’t cut corners which is so important when it comes to a high dollar item like countertops. Everyone on their crew is amazing from Ginger at the front line to their install crew and owners! Thank you Melling Granite! We love our counters.
